notes.title: Saved “as if through the flames”
notes.intro: Paul says each person’s work will be tested by fire; some will be saved, “but only as if through the flames.”

views.label: A biblical basis for purgatory
views.summary: Catholics see here a hint of a purifying process after death for those saved but not yet fully purified.

views.label: About the judgement of teachers’ work at the last day
views.summary: Most Protestants read it as Christ testing the work of church leaders at the final judgement, not a place after death.

views.label: A purifying fire, without defining purgatory
views.summary: Orthodox Christians speak of the purifying encounter with God’s love but generally do not accept purgatory as defined by Rome.
views.source: Fr Thomas Hopko, The Orthodox Faith, vol. 4
